summary: Slow juggernaut with heavy magic damage, a shield that converts into healing, and a level 5 ult that traps you alone with him. He has no dash, so kiting and dodging his Q and E are how you beat him.
threats: Q (Obliterate) is his main damage and hits harder on an isolated target; don't stand alone in front of him.
E (Death's Grasp) pulls you in and gives him magic penetration. It's his only way to stick to you.
Passive (Darkness Rise): after three hits he gets a damage aura, so long fights favor him.
R (Realm of Death) at 5 takes you into a 1v1 and steals your stats. Your team can't help you.

matchups.why: Mordekaiser has no dash, so Vayne kites him all lane. W (Silver Bolts) true damage ignores his shield-turned-HP, and Condemn knocks him out of Q range.
trading: Auto him whenever he walks up to farm; he can't reach you without E.
Tumble (Q) sideways out of his E pull and Q.
Condemn him into a wall if he walks at you.
Inside his R, keep kiting; he still needs to land Q to win.
matchups.early: Kite and farm. He's slow, so never let him walk into melee range for free.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R traps you with him. Keep Tumble ready to dodge his Q inside the realm.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and kite; take plates when he backs.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape. Gank whenever he's past mid-lane.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo. Crit and on-hit; MR boots against his magic damage.

matchups.why: Riposte parries Mordekaiser's E pull and stuns him back, and vitals' true damage ignores his shield. Fiora even wins inside his R because the realm makes it a pure 1v1, which is her strength.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his E pull; parry it and stun him back.
Lunge onto vitals and back off before his passive aura builds.
Dodge his Q by Lunging sideways; it's a narrow cone.
Inside his R, save W for his Q to block his main damage.
matchups.early: Trade on vitals from level 1 and push him under tower; he's slow to answer.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R makes it a 1v1. Your R heal zone and vitals win it if you parry his Q.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and take plates while he's stuck farming under tower.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape. Gank once he's used E.
matchups.remember: Parry the pull, Riposte the Q in the realm.

matchups.why: Both are slow juggernauts. Darius out-damages Mordekaiser early with bleed stacks, but Mordekaiser's shield and Q isolation damage trade back hard. The lane comes down to who lands their pull first.
trading: E (Apprehend) pull him when he walks up; stack Hemorrhage fast.
Step out of his E pull path and Q cone.
Hit the outer edge of Q on him to heal through his shield.
Back off when his passive aura is active.
matchups.early: Even. Trade when his E is down; you can't reach him if he's holding it for your pull.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R traps you; your R resets on kill. Count stacks before going in.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and trade on cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: He has no escape. Gank when he's past mid-lane.
matchups.build: Conqueror. MR boots against his magic damage.

matchups.why: Mordekaiser's damage is magic, so Malphite's armor stacking does nothing. His R steals Malphite's stats and isolates him from his jungler, and Malphite can't kill him alone.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him when he walks up to farm, then walk away with the speed.
Step out of his E pull path; that's his only way to reach you.
Don't stand next to minions alone; his Q hurts more on an isolated target.
Buy MR early; armor won't help you here.
matchups.early: Farm safely, accept some poke, and rush an MR item before trading at all.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R removes you from your team. Stay near your tower when his R is up.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; he can't dive you early.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks; your R and your jungler can kill him once his R is down.
matchups.build: Grasp. MR boots and early MR items.
